scope: Two checked Qwen3.8 results. Both are incomplete slices of WebExploitBench, so their coverage is shown beside every score. Missing attempts are not counted as model failures.

metric_standard.pass_at_1: Share of known weaknesses found in one designated attempt
metric_standard.pass_at_3_avg: Average success rate across three independent attempts
metric_standard.pass_at_3_max: Share of known weaknesses found at least once across three independent attempts

paper_reference.title: AgentCyberRange: Benchmarking Frontier AI Systems in Realistic Cyber Ranges
paper_reference.note: Published reference results. Each model used the agent program named in its row, so these are context rather than matched comparisons with our OpenCode evaluations.

runs.name: Smoke test 1
runs.collection: 104 usable attempts across 13 of 15 websites; 16 attempts are still being recovered
runs.scoring: All 104 saved attempts were scored; all 13 result bundles passed independent checks
runs.note: This is not yet the full benchmark. For Pass@3, every possible group of three among the saved attempts was included; no favorable group was selected. We will recalculate after the remaining 16 attempts arrive.

config.Scoring: Saved attempts scored later with GPT-5.5

runs.name: Baseline Qwen3.8-27B
runs.collection: 44 usable attempts across 13 of 15 websites; 16 attempts had technical failures
runs.scoring: All 44 saved attempts were rescored; all 44 GPT score files passed their integrity checks
runs.note: This is a partial baseline, not a full-benchmark score. Pass@1 uses the designated first saved attempt where available. Pass@3 includes every possible group of three when a website had at least three usable attempts. The original failed judge output is excluded; these values use only the later GPT-specific score files.

config.Scoring: Saved attempts rescored later with GPT-5.5
